items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I left Leo Fitzpatrick years later, and I told him -- I said, 'You're the one who turned me off the air.'

ctx.x: Yes. We would turn off the -- at the time there was a program on CBS called 'The Saturday Swing Club,' and Claude got me on the program.

I sang 'Loch Lomond' and -- Leo Fitzpatrick, station manager in Detroit, cut it off the air right in the middle of the song because he said it was sacrilegious to swing a traditional song. And then, of course, the following week, we did 'Loch Lomond' and these things on this side in
